messages:
Sam: Postmortem follow-up: we need owners + tight ETAs for the remaining KV-cache workstreams. Focus areas: fragmentation profiling, GC tuning, per-tenant caps, and the sharding rebalance guard. Who volunteers?

Ivy: I can own fragmentation profiling and the allocation lifetimes analysis. Will run focused heap diffs and produce an action doc with stack traces. ETA: Wed EOD.

Harper: I'll take GC/compaction experiments. Plan: try background-only compaction, incremental passes, and threshold sweeps. Benchmark latency regressions in staging. ETA: next Tue.

Diego: I'll prototype per-tenant soft caps and a write-slowdown path (token-bucket fallback) to prevent one noisy tenant from OOMing a shard. ETA: Mon midday.

Nico: I'll work on a sharding rebalance guard so we don't push data to a node that's within 5% of mem limit. Add a safe-rebalance flag to the controller. ETA: Thu.

Sam: Good. Ivy, please include exact commands and sample heap diffs so SRE can validate.

Ivy: Commands I'll include: `HEAPPROFILE=/tmp/heap ./kvnode --scenario=prefix-churn && pprof --text /tmp/heap.*` plus `sudo gcore <pid>` for dump. Attaching a small script too.

Harper: Draft GC params: `--kv-compact-threshold=0.22 --compact-background=true --compact-window=30s`. Will test latency p95/p99 and compaction CPU.

Diego: Soft-cap strategy: soft limit at 48k per-prefix, degrade to write-slowdown at 64k, then eviction hint at 80k. We'll tune values based on miss-rate.

Nico: Rebalance guard: controller checks node_mem_headroom > 7% before moving shards; will emit diagnostic event `rebalance_blocked_due_to_mem`.

Sam: Ops: add metrics for prevented rebalances and tenant throttles. Also add an alert for sustained per-node mem_headroom < 6%.

OpsBot: Reminder: add owners to the postmortem board card. Required fields: owner / task / ETA / test-plan link / rollback-risk.

Ivy: Found an interesting pattern: fragmentation increases when many small prefixes are promoted to long-lived cache entries. I'll add a repro that grows prefix table size gradually.

Harper: If fragmentation is the issue, compact-on-idle might help. I'll prototype a low-priority compaction pass that runs only when CPU < 15%.

Diego: For the write-slowdown, I'll add a client error code (429 kv_tenant_throttle) and a transparent retry hint so caller libraries can backoff gracefully.

Nico: I'll gate the rebalance guard behind a feature flag `--safe-rebalance` so ops can enable gradually. Also adding a metric `rebalance_blocked_count`.

Sam: Recap and locked owners:
- Ivy: fragmentation profiling + reproducible scripts (ETA Wed EOD)
- Harper: GC/compaction experiments + benchmarks (ETA Tue)
- Diego: per-tenant caps + write-slowdown prototype (ETA Mon)
- Nico: sharding rebalance guard + controller metric (ETA Thu)
- Sam: update postmortem board + schedule 30m sync Friday 09:30

Ivy: Uploading initial diffs to the postmortem doc now.

Harper: Will post benchmark harness and a config matrix in the card.

Diego: PR draft created: `feat/tenant-softcap` 478. Adding unit tests.

Nico: Draft controller change up in branch `safe-rebalance`. Will link when tests pass.

OpsBot: Calendar invite created: "KV-cache remediation sync" Fri 09:30. Card updated with owners.

Sam: Thanks all. If anyone slips on ETA, update the board and ping me. We'll prioritize customer-facing mitigations first.
